//go:build finalqualification

package delivery

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/base64"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"net"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"os"
	"reflect"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"testing"
)

type finalQualificationCustody struct{}

func (finalQualificationCustody) Use(ctx context.Context, i Intent, fn func([]byte) error) error {
	return fn([]byte("synthetic-fixture-only"))
}

type finalQualificationPrivacy struct{}

func (finalQualificationPrivacy) Review(context.Context, Intent, Plan) error { return nil }

type FinalQualificationRemote struct {
	sync.Mutex
	Calls                         int
	Writes                        int
	present                       map[string]bool
	published, pr, merged, closed bool
}

func (f *FinalQualificationRemote) Count() int { f.Lock(); defer f.Unlock(); return f.Calls }
func finalProtection() map[string]any {
	return map[string]any{
		"enforce_admins":         map[string]bool{"enabled": true},
		"required_status_checks": map[string]any{"strict": true, "contexts": []string{"test"}, "checks": []any{}},
		"required_pull_request_reviews": map[string]any{
			"required_approving_review_count": 1, "dismiss_stale_reviews": true, "require_last_push_approval": true,
			"bypass_pull_request_allowances": map[string]any{"users": []any{}, "teams": []any{}, "apps": []any{}},
		},
	}
}
func FinalQualificationProtection() string { return digest(finalProtection()) }

// Only compiled by the source-owned finalqualification overlay. Never changes
// the production constructor, origin, credential policy or transport.
func FinalQualificationGitHub(t *testing.T, p Plan) (*GitHub, *FinalQualificationRemote) {
	t.Helper()
	f := &FinalQualificationRemote{present: map[string]bool{}}
	objects := map[string]GitObject{}
	for _, o := range p.Objects {
		objects[o.OID] = o
	}
	mergeSpec := p.Commit
	mergeSpec.Message = "Controlled squash result\n"
	mergeObject, e := authoredObject(mergeSpec)
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	merge := mergeObject.OID
	prefix := "/repos/" + p.Repository
	person := func(i Identity) map[string]string {
		return map[string]string{"name": i.Name, "email": i.Email, "date": p.Commit.Timestamp}
	}
	pull := func() map[string]any {
		state, sha := "open", ""
		if f.merged {
			state, sha = "closed", merge
		}
		return map[string]any{"html_url": fmt.Sprintf("https://github.com/%s/pull/7", p.Repository), "user": map[string]string{"login": p.Actor}, "number": 7, "state": state, "draft": false, "merged": f.merged, "merge_commit_sha": sha, "mergeable": true, "mergeable_state": "clean", "title": p.PRTitle, "body": p.PRBody, "head": map[string]any{"sha": p.Head, "ref": p.Branch, "repo": map[string]any{"id": p.RepositoryID, "full_name": p.Repository}}, "base": map[string]any{"sha": p.BaseHead, "ref": p.Base, "repo": map[string]any{"id": p.RepositoryID, "full_name": p.Repository}}}
	}
	srv := httptest.NewUnstartedServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		f.Lock()
		defer f.Unlock()
		f.Calls++
		if r.Method != "GET" {
			f.Writes++
		}
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		send := func(v any) { _ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(v) }
		if r.Header.Get("Authorization") != "Bearer synthetic-fixture-only" {
			http.Error(w, "fixture credential missing", 401)
			return
		}
		path := r.URL.Path
		switch {
		case path == "/user":
			send(map[string]any{"id": 42, "login": p.Actor})
		case path == prefix:
			send(map[string]any{"id": p.RepositoryID, "full_name": p.Repository, "default_branch": p.Base, "permissions": map[string]bool{"push": true}, "allow_squash_merge": true})
		case path == prefix+"/rules/branches/"+p.Base:
			send([]any{})
		case path == prefix+"/branches/"+p.Base+"/protection":
			send(finalProtection())
		case path == prefix+"/collaborators/"+p.Actor+"/permission":
			send(map[string]string{"permission": "write", "role_name": "write"})
		case path == prefix+"/git/ref/heads/"+p.Base:
			head := p.BaseHead
			if f.merged {
				head = merge
			}
			send(map[string]any{"ref": "refs/heads/" + p.Base, "object": map[string]string{"sha": head}})
		case path == prefix+"/git/ref/heads/"+p.Branch:
			if !f.published {
				http.Error(w, "absent", 404)
				return
			}
			send(map[string]any{"ref": "refs/heads/" + p.Branch, "object": map[string]string{"sha": p.Head}})
		case path == prefix+"/git/refs":
			var req struct{ Ref, SHA string }
			if json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req) != nil || req.Ref != "refs/heads/"+p.Branch || req.SHA != p.Head {
				http.Error(w, "wrong ref", 422)
				return
			}
			f.published = true
			send(map[string]any{"ref": req.Ref, "object": map[string]string{"sha": p.Head}})
		case path == prefix+"/pulls":
			if r.Method == "POST" {
				var req struct {
					Head, Base, Title, Body string
					Draft                   bool
				}
				if json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req) != nil || req.Head != p.Branch || req.Base != p.Base || req.Draft || req.Title != p.PRTitle || req.Body != p.PRBody {
					http.Error(w, "wrong PR", 422)
					return
				}
				f.pr = true
				send(pull())
				return
			}
			if f.pr {
				send([]any{pull()})
			} else {
				send([]any{})
			}
		case path == prefix+"/pulls/7":
			send(pull())
		case path == prefix+"/pulls/7/reviews":
			send([]any{map[string]any{"id": 1, "user": map[string]string{"login": "reviewer"}, "state": "APPROVED", "commit_id": p.Head, "submitted_at": "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z"}})
		case path == prefix+"/pulls/7/merge":
			var req struct {
				SHA         string `json:"sha"`
				MergeMethod string `json:"merge_method"`
			}
			if json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req) != nil || req.SHA != p.Head || req.MergeMethod != p.MergeMethod {
				http.Error(w, "wrong reviewed merge", 422)
				return
			}
			f.merged = true
			send(map[string]any{"merged": true, "sha": merge})
		case strings.HasSuffix(path, "/check-runs"):
			parts := strings.Split(path, "/")
			head := parts[len(parts)-2]
			conclusion := "success"
			if strings.Contains(t.Name(), "FailedChecks") {
				conclusion = "failure"
			}
			send(map[string]any{"total_count": 1, "check_runs": []any{map[string]any{"id": 123, "app": map[string]any{"id": 55, "slug": "ci"}, "name": "test", "head_sha": head, "status": "completed", "conclusion": conclusion}}})
		case strings.HasSuffix(path, "/status"):
			send(map[string]any{"total_count": 0, "statuses": []any{}})
		case strings.HasPrefix(path, prefix+"/compare/"):
			send(map[string]any{"status": "identical", "behind_by": 0})
		case path == prefix+"/issues/"+strconv.FormatUint(p.Intake.Source.URL.Number, 10):
			if r.Method == "PATCH" {
				var req struct {
					State       string
					StateReason string `json:"state_reason"`
				}
				if json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req) != nil || req.State != "closed" || req.StateReason != "completed" {
					http.Error(w, "wrong issue", 422)
					return
				}
				f.closed = true
			}
			state, reason := "open", ""
			if f.closed {
				state, reason = "closed", "completed"
			}
			send(map[string]any{"id": p.Intake.Source.IssueID, "number": p.Intake.Source.URL.Number, "state": state, "state_reason": reason})
		case strings.HasPrefix(path, prefix+"/git/"):
			tail := strings.TrimPrefix(path, prefix+"/git/")
			parts := strings.Split(tail, "/")
			kind := strings.TrimSuffix(parts[0], "s")
			if len(parts) == 1 && r.Method == "POST" {
				var found GitObject
				switch kind {
				case "blob":
					var req struct{ Content, Encoding string }
					if json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req) != nil || req.Encoding != "base64" {
						http.Error(w, "bad blob", 422)
						return
					}
					b, err := base64.StdEncoding.DecodeString(req.Content)
					if err != nil {
						http.Error(w, "bad base64", 422)
						return
					}
					found = GitObject{Kind: "blob", OID: objectOID("blob", b), Raw: b}
				case "tree":
					var req struct{ Tree []treeEntry }
					if json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req) != nil {
						http.Error(w, "bad tree", 422)
						return
					}
					for _, o := range p.Objects {
						if o.Kind == "tree" {
							entries, e := treeEntries(o.Raw)
							if e == nil && reflect.DeepEqual(entries, req.Tree) {
								found = o
							}
						}
					}
				case "commit":
					var req gitCommitPayload
					if json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req) != nil {
						http.Error(w, "bad commit", 422)
						return
					}
					for _, o := range p.Objects {
						if o.Kind == "commit" {
							expected, e := commitPayload(o)
							if e == nil && reflect.DeepEqual(expected, req) {
								found = o
							}
						}
					}
				}
				expected, ok := objects[found.OID]
				if !ok || !reflect.DeepEqual(expected, found) {
					http.Error(w, "unapproved object", 422)
					return
				}
				f.present[found.OID] = true
				send(map[string]string{"sha": found.OID})
				return
			}
			if len(parts) != 2 {
				http.Error(w, "bad object path", 404)
				return
			}
			id := parts[1]
			if kind == "commit" && id == p.BaseHead {
				send(map[string]string{"sha": id})
				return
			}
			if kind == "commit" && id == merge {
				send(map[string]any{"sha": id, "message": mergeSpec.Message, "tree": map[string]string{"sha": p.Commit.Tree}, "parents": []any{map[string]string{"sha": p.BaseHead}}, "author": person(p.Commit.Author), "committer": person(p.Commit.Committer)})
				return
			}
			o, ok := objects[id]
			if !ok || !f.present[id] {
				http.Error(w, "absent", 404)
				return
			}
			switch kind {
			case "blob":
				send(map[string]string{"sha": id, "encoding": "base64", "content": base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(o.Raw)})
			case "tree":
				entries, e := treeEntries(o.Raw)
				if e != nil {
					t.Error(e)
				}
				send(map[string]any{"sha": id, "truncated": false, "tree": entries})
			case "commit":
				payload, e := commitPayload(o)
				if e != nil {
					t.Error(e)
				}
				send(map[string]any{"sha": id, "message": payload.Message, "tree": map[string]string{"sha": payload.Tree}, "parents": []any{map[string]string{"sha": payload.Parents[0]}}, "author": payload.Author, "committer": payload.Committer})
			default:
				http.Error(w, "unsupported kind", 404)
			}
		default:
			t.Errorf("unhandled fixture endpoint %s %s", r.Method, path)
			http.Error(w, "unsupported fixture", 404)
		}
	}))
	// The engineering helper retains the shared lifetime lock. Never silently
	// bind an ephemeral/out-of-pool port when it was not used.
	_ = srv.Listener.Close()
	port, portErr := strconv.Atoi(os.Getenv("AEGIS_ACCEPTANCE_PORT"))
	if portErr != nil || port < 8450 || port > 8469 {
		t.Fatal("final qualification requires shared acceptance_port.py lifetime custody")
	}
	listener, listenErr := net.Listen("tcp", fmt.Sprintf("127.0.0.1:%d", port))
	if listenErr != nil { t.Fatal(listenErr) }
	srv.Listener = listener
	srv.Start()
	t.Cleanup(srv.Close)
	remote, e := newGitHub(srv.URL, finalQualificationCustody{}, finalQualificationPrivacy{})
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	return remote, f
}
